title: Vector Humanities: humanities research in and on the vector medium
description: The website of Vector Humanities, a research lab directed by David M. Berry at the University of Sussex. It documents projects that take the vector medium as both the instrument and the object of humanities research: the Vector Lab instruments, the vector translation of Kuki Shūzō's The Problem of Contingency, the Vector Humanities Editions & Contingencies book series, the Melville Research Bench, critical code studies readings of ELIZA, Spacewar! and SHRDLU, and Nostos as a case of vector literature. It also sets out vector toolmaking and the lab's working conventions on provenance, AI disclosure, instrument and material, and open access.
